name: Is epoxy or polyaspartic better for garage flooring?

mainEntity.name: Is epoxy or polyaspartic better for garage flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Polyaspartic is often the better choice for Colorado garages because it handles UV exposure and temperature swings better than standard epoxy. Epoxy can still work well when sunlight is limited and the concrete is in good shape, but polyaspartic usually offers faster return-to-service and stronger color stability. The right choice depends on your budget, durability goals, and how much sun the garage gets.
